	self.session.custom.procurexViewDateTo = ''
	system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'HeaderToolbar', 'message': 'Navigate: Procurex (all)'}, scope='session')
	system.perspective.navigate('/procurex')

system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'message': '[HeaderToolbar] VXSearchPill clicked'}, scope='session')
	system.perspective.openPopup('vxQuickSearch', 'Workmate/VisualX/VX_QuickSearch', showCloseIcon=False, draggable=False, resizable=False, modal=True, overlayDismiss=False)

if not self.session.custom.get('activePage', ''):
		self.session.custom['activePage'] = ''
	try:
		username = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'onStartup: loading prefs for ' + str(username)}, scope='session')
		results = system.db.runNamedQuery('Workmate/Tips/GetUserPrefs', {'username': username})
		if results.rowCount > 0:
			showVal = bool(results.getValueAt(0, 'ShowTips'))
			dismVal = str(results.getValueAt(0, 'DismissedTips') or '')
			self.session.custom['showTips'] = showVal
			self.session.custom['dismissedTips'] = dismVal
			system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'Loaded: showTips=' + str(showVal) + ', dismissed=' + dismVal}, scope='session')
		else:
			self.session.custom['showTips'] = True
			self.session.custom['dismissedTips'] = ''
			system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'No prefs found, defaults set'}, scope='session')
	except Exception as e:
		self.session.custom['showTips'] = True
		self.session.custom['dismissedTips'] = ''
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'onStartup ERROR: ' + str(e)}, scope='session')
	# --- BRAND-B1: gateway-wide brand mode (v16.39) ---
	# Truth lives in System_Configuration; mirrored onto the session prop so
	# every brand binding subscribes reactively and the System popup can flip
	# it without this view being involved.
	try:
		self.session.custom.wmBrandMode = workmate.brand.get_mode()
	except:
		self.session.custom.wmBrandMode = 'WORKMATE'
	system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Brand', 'message': 'Brand mode loaded: ' + str(self.session.custom.wmBrandMode)}, scope='session')

messageHandlers.script:
# Receive tab change notification
	isHistory = payload.get('isHistoryTab', False)
	self.view.custom.isHistoryTab = isHistory
	system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Toolbar', 'message': 'History tab mode: ' + str(isHistory)}, scope='session')

try:
		tipId = payload.get('tipId', '')
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'tips-dismiss received, tipId=' + str(tipId)}, scope='session')
		if not tipId:
			return
		dismissedStr = self.session.custom.get('dismissedTips', '')
		dismissed = [t.strip() for t in str(dismissedStr).split(',') if t.strip()] if dismissedStr else []
		if tipId not in dismissed:
			dismissed.append(tipId)
			newStr = ','.join(dismissed)
			self.session.custom['dismissedTips'] = newStr
			username = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
			system.db.runNamedQuery('Workmate/Tips/DismissTip', {'username': username, 'tipId': tipId})
			system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'Dismissed ' + tipId + ', total=' + newStr}, scope='session')
		else:
			system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': tipId + ' already dismissed'}, scope='session')
		# Broadcast refresh to all TipBadges
		system.perspective.sendMessage('tips-refresh', {}, scope='session')
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'tips-refresh broadcast sent'}, scope='session')
	except Exception as e:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'tips-dismiss ERROR: ' + str(e)}, scope='session')

try:
		currentShow = self.session.custom.get('showTips', True)
		newShow = not currentShow
		self.session.custom['showTips'] = newShow
		username = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
		system.db.runNamedQuery('Workmate/Tips/SetShowTips', {'username': username, 'showTips': newShow})
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'tips-toggle: showTips=' + str(newShow) + ' for ' + username}, scope='session')
		# Broadcast refresh to all TipBadges
		system.perspective.sendMessage('tips-refresh', {}, scope='session')
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'tips-refresh broadcast sent'}, scope='session')
	except Exception as e:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'tips-toggle ERROR: ' + str(e)}, scope='session')

try:
		self.session.custom['dismissedTips'] = ''
		self.session.custom['showTips'] = True
		username = self.session.props.auth.user.userName
		system.db.runNamedQuery('Workmate/Tips/ResetAllTips', {'username': username})
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'tips-reset for ' + username}, scope='session')
		# Broadcast refresh to all TipBadges
		system.perspective.sendMessage('tips-refresh', {}, scope='session')
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'tips-refresh broadcast sent'}, scope='session')
	except Exception as e:
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'Tips', 'message': 'tips-reset ERROR: ' + str(e)}, scope='session')

# Receive active page notification from content views
	page = payload.get('page', '')
	self.session.custom['activePage'] = page
	system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'HeaderToolbar', 'message': 'nav-active: ' + str(page)}, scope='session')

# S6 AI navigator bridge - the chat surface (workmate-ai, future)
	# sends ui_action payloads here with scope='page' (page-local UI motion
	# - session scope fires once per open tab, verified 2026-08-12);
	# workmate.nav.execute is the single
	# allow-listed executor. Dark until workmate.nav.AI_NAV_ENABLED.
	try:
		res = workmate.nav.execute(self.session, payload)
		system.perspective.sendMessage('debug-log', {'source': 'AINav', 'message': 'ui_action result: ' + str(res)}, scope='session')
	except:
		import sys as _s
		system.util.getLogger('AINav').warn('[AINav] handler: ' + str(_s.exc_info()[1]))
